messages:
amy_onboard: Hi team — day 2. Stuck on Okta MFA setup. When I attempt to register my security key I get 'No security key found' and the modal loops. Also, the onboarding Drive folder link in my welcome note says 'Request access'. Who do I ask?
sarah-it: Welcome @amy_onboard! Ping @it-identity for provisioning. For the key, which browser and OS?
amy_onboard: macOS Ventura, Chrome 121. YubiKey 5C Nano (USB-C) plugged direct. Tried rebooting.
it-identity: I can't see your Google group assignment yet. I'll trigger a SCIM sync. For the YubiKey, sometimes Chrome blocks WebAuthn; try Safari or an incognito window.
dave-devex: Also check for corporate privacy extensions that block security keys. Did you get the Google Workspace welcome email?
amy_onboard: I got the welcome but no Drive links. I tried Safari incognito and still got the same 'No security key found' message.
okta-bot: Okta: Activation email delivered to amy@redwood.com at 1763014800.
sarah-it: Can you run this command and paste output?
```
system_profiler SPUSBDataType | grep -i yubico -A2
```
amy_onboard: Shows: "Yubico YubiKey 5C Nano" on hub.
sarah-it: Hardware visible. Next, go to chrome://settings/content/securityKeys (or Settings -> Privacy and security -> Security keys) and ensure site permissions are allowed for okta.redwood.com. Also try disabling extensions.
amy_onboard: Disabled Privacy Badger and uBlock. Cleared site settings and tried incognito. Now Okta detected the key and prompted for touch. Registration completed. Thanks!
it-identity: I pushed the group mapping; you should get folder access after reloading Drive. If still blocked, sign out and back into your Google account.
amy_onboard: Drive folder is visible now and I got the 1Password invite. Quick question: where do we store the YubiKey recovery codes? Company policy?
dave-devex: Put recovery codes in the company 1Password vault under an "MFA Backup" item and mark the item as restricted if necessary. See #eng-security for labels.
amy_onboard: Done — saved in 1Password. Appreciate the quick help! :tada:
